script.base: Roof-closed, low-total game (40.5; SEA 22.0 / ARI 18.5) with Seattle -3.5 and Sam Darnold out, so Drew Lock game-manages. Neither side pulls away; SEA leans on J.Price (10/52 wk1) and G.Holani (8/29) to protect Lock despite G Anthony Bradford out, and ARI stays in it with T.Allgeier (17/61) plus T.McBride (13 targets). Halftime is one-score, late snaps stay on the field, and 122-yard or 75-yard skill spikes are not the base path.
script.flip1: SEA scores early, leads by two scores, kills the clock with Price carries, JSN/Kupp/Shaheed routes stall, and ARI abandons Allgeier so McBride/K.Bourne/Mi.Wilson targets rise but SEA's week-1 pass defense (0-of-36 gains of 20+) caps the yards.
script.flip2: Lock misfires or ARI's depleted secondary (CB Garrett Williams out) gifts explosives, ARI leads, Allgeier clock-kills, and SEA throws late so JSN's 11-target share threatens 122.5.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse report, not inactives: SEA QB Sam Darnold Out (Glute) so Lock is the QB (only pack evidence is wk1 1 rush, 14 yards) — pass ceiling down for JSN, C.Kupp, R.Shaheed, B.Russell; SEA G Anthony Bradford Out (Knee) — rush efficiency down for Price and Holani, more quick throws. SEA S Ty Okada Out (Hamstring) and S Nick Emmanwori Questionable (Ankle) — ARI downfield options gain: McBride (89 air), Mi.Wilson (83 air), M.Harrison (71 air). ARI CB Garrett Williams Out (Achilles), CB Max Melton Q (Ankle), S Dadrion Taylor-Demerson Q (Ribs) — SEA pass-catchers, especially JSN, face a thinner secondary (cuts against a JSN under). ARI DT Andrew Billings Q (Knee) and DT Roy Lopez Q (Groin) — if both sit, Price/Holani rush matchup improves. ARI G Isaac Seumalo Q (Shoulder) and G Isaiah Adams Q (Knee) — if they sit or are limited, Allgeier/J.Love rush efficiency drops. No final inactives in the pack.

matchup.pressure: ARI blitzes only 17%; SEA wk1 EPA/db was better vs blitz (+0.30) than not (+0.17), so Arizona will not give Lock the look Seattle handled. SEA blitzes 26%; ARI EPA/db falls to +0.13 vs blitz from +0.34 with no blitz, so heat shrinks Arizona's downfield efficiency and pushes checkdowns.
matchup.bleeds: ARI bleeds the middle (12.86 YPA) and allowed 2 gains of 20+ on 30 throws; rush defense 3.86 YPC, 2 runs of 10+. SEA does not bleed explosives (0 of 36) and held the run to 3.52 YPC with 3 runs of 10+; modest middle 7.0 YPA is 4 attempts only.
matchup.overlap: SEA's primary is JSN (11 tgt, 122 yds, 76 air) into the exact ARI middle bleed plus a secondary missing Williams — that overlap favors JSN and is why his under is only a lean. ARI's primary is McBride (13 tgt, 95 yds, 89 air) into a SEA defense that showed no explosives, offset by Okada out / Emmanwori Q.

No similar-defense or same-script comp in the pack. Lines are stand-in medians of that one game, so form equals the number, not a trend.

Darnold out lowers the SEA pass ceiling versus the wk1 sample the stand-in lines copy.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. JSN under lost because Williams was inactive, Melton and Taylor-Demerson sat, and Lock fed JSN 12 targets with a 40-yard middle shot — the depleted secondary was the game, not the 22-point team total. Allgeier under lost because it was a 20-17 roof slog, Seumalo and Adams played, Arizona ran 30-plus times, and Allgeier took 19 carries near 3.6 YPC while Love was scripted down. That counter is strong enough that both legs stay leans, not bets, until inactives and a real price exist.
slip_story: One story only: low-total SEA control with Lock, not a shootout. JSN does not need to repeat 122, and Allgeier does not get a positive-script 17-carry day if Arizona is the dog throwing into a 26% blitz. Do not add McBride/Bourne/Wilson overs (they need the trailing-pass flip) or Price over (Bradford is Out and Holani already took 8 carries). Two legs, no TDs, one market per player.
